summary: The Denial is a 1925 American silent drama film directed by Hobart Henley. It stars Claire Windsor, Bert Roach, William Haines, Lucille Ricksen and Robert Agnew. The screenplay by Agnes Christine Johnston was based on the play "The Square Peg" by Lewis Beach.
one_line: The Denial is a 1925 American silent drama film directed by Hobart Henley, adapted from Lewis Beach's play "The Square Peg".
key_facts: The Denial is a 1925 American silent drama film.
The Denial was directed by Hobart Henley.
The Denial stars Claire Windsor, Bert Roach, William Haines, Lucille Ricksen and Robert Agnew.
The Denial was written by Agnes Christine Johnston.
The Denial is based on the play "The Square Peg" by Lewis Beach.
